name: Aspect of the Storm
body:
School transmutation [electricity]; Level druid 8

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range personal

Target self

Duration 1 min./level (D)

You float into the air, lifted by swirling winds and electricity courses through you, crackling along your body. You gain a 40 ft. fly speed and are immune to ranged non-spell ranged attacks. You are also not affected by high winds whether mundane or magical.

Additionally, as a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, you can release a bolt of lightning. This bolt has a range of 100 feet as a ranged touch attack, and you gain a +3 circumstance bonus on this attack if the target is bearing a metal object, wearing metal armor, or made of metal. This ability allows the target to apply their spell resistance if applicable. The bolt deals 1d6 electricity damage per caster level, maximum 10d6.
